summary: Multi-recipient sends: contract, price offer, WhatsApp tab, task, meeting flows can pick several lead contacts (WhatsApp + email); signed contract returns to all
Profit page: summary cards reflow on phones (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 + clamped amount size) so six/seven-figure totals stop spilling outside the card
Lead deep links (/?lead=ID) from calendar/WhatsApp/email/AI chat always open the lead card — RootRedirect skips the last-mode redirect when the param is present and switches to מכירות

LeadCard mobile: header wraps (delete icon-only, badges own row), scroll body overflow-x-hidden + wrap-anywhere on long emails/URLs, WhatsApp bubble min-w-0 — no sideways overflow at 360/390/430; desktop unchanged

Phone layout round 2: AdminPage user rows wrap (name flex-1 basis-24, pills shrink), flex-1 inputs min-w-0; LeadCard FilesSection name button w-full wrap-break-word sm:truncate — zero overflow at 360/390, desktop unchanged
